Docket 1.3.134

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $349, or 4 payments of $87.25, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *An address written in capitals is an address.* A business whose header gives its full street address
  with the town in capital letters was told it did not look like a local business, and none of the local
  checks ran. Docket now reads a whole US address line ending in a town, a state code and a ZIP code,
  however it is capitalised, and the address checks find it too.
- *A title that names your state names a location.* A country inn whose every page title includes the
  name of its state, the same state as its own address, was told no page title mentioned a location.

99 checks across 13 areas.
